title: M-ANT: Efficient Low-bit Group Quantization for LLMs via Mathematically Adaptive Numerical Type
problem: Existing adaptive data types for LLM group quantization provide adaptivity at the tensor level, but small quantization groups within the same tensor exhibit markedly different distributions that tensor-level formats cannot accommodate. Additionally, dynamically generated KV caches require efficient real-time quantization that existing approaches do not support well.
motivation: Group-wise quantization has become the standard for LLM deployment, but the group-level distribution diversity demands a new level of per-group adaptivity to minimize accuracy loss at ultra-low bit widths.
method: MANT defines a mathematically adaptive numeric type with a flexible encoding paradigm covering a wider range of data distributions than prior adaptive types. A hardware framework assigns the appropriate MANT variant to each quantization group dynamically. A dedicated processing element (PE) fuses decoding and computation, and a real-time quantization unit handles dynamic KV cache quantization. These PEs are integrated into a systolic array, unifying weight and KV cache quantization in a single datapath.
key_novelty: A per-group adaptive numeric type with a decoding-computation fusion mechanism that simultaneously handles both weight quantization and real-time KV cache quantization in a systolic array accelerator.
contributions: MANT adaptive numeric type with flexible encoding and wider distribution coverage than prior adaptive types
Group-level adaptive assignment framework that selects the appropriate data type per quantization group
Real-time quantization unit for dynamic KV cache quantization
Systolic-array PE design with decoding-computation fusion achieving 2.99x average speedup and 2.81x energy reduction

metrics.speedup: 2.99x average (up to 4.46x) over state-of-the-art LLM accelerator

limitations: The specific baseline accelerator and LLM models used for comparison are not named in the abstract.
primary_theme: per-group adaptive quantization for LLM accelerators
